title: An open A shape
summary: Change one sound from A minor.

steps.title: An open A shape
steps.body:
A means A major: A, C# and E. Compare it with Am, which uses C instead of C#. Keep open string 5, fret 2 on strings 4 and 3, and open string 1. Move string 2 from fret 1 to fret 2. Leave string 6 out.

**Why it matters:** One changed note turns the minor shape into major without changing its root.

steps.title: Read the positions
steps.body: Read string 6 as x, string 5 as 0, strings 4, 3 and 2 as fret 2, and string 1 as 0. The C# on string 2 is the changed sound; the root is still A.

items.prompt: Play A, E, C# together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Compare the sounds
steps.body: Clear the taps with Escape between chords. Compare Am and A slowly. On your guitar, check each pressed string separately rather than squeezing harder.

items.prompt: Play A, E, C# together. Use any positions for these notes.
